caption:
बॉक्स ऑफिस पर रामायण फिल्म का जलवा ऐसा है कि हर कोई हैरान रह गया है!
डायरेक्टर Nitesh Tiwari की इस फिल्म ने दूसरे रविवार, 15 नवंबर को कमाई के सारे रिकॉर्ड तोड़ दिए हैं।
थिएटर में पहला सुबह का शो शुरू होने से पहले ही फिल्म ने 37.10 करोड़ gross की धांसू एडवांस बुकिंग कर ली है।
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, 24,500 शोज में 11.49 लाख टिकट बिकने से 31.40 करोड़ net कलेक्शन सिर्फ एडवांस से आ गया है।
इस जबरदस्त कमाई के साथ फिल्म ने Dhurandhar को पीछे छोड़ दिया है और टॉप 5 बिगेस्ट 11th डे में एंट्री ले ली है।
Animal का रिकॉर्ड तोड़ने के लिए सिर्फ 2.14 करोड़ और Jawan के लिए 2.87 करोड़ over-the-counter बुकिंग की जरूरत है।
क्या रामायण फिल्म Dhurandhar 2 का 63 करोड़ का रिकॉर्ड तोड़ पाएगी?

ctx.title: Ramayana Box Office Day 11 Advance Booking: Beats Dhurandhar To Enter Top 5 Biggest 11th Day Before First Show On 2nd Sunday Begins!
ctx.summary:
Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana is standing in the top 10 biggest second Sundays, and top 5 biggest day 11 with the advance booking alone! 
 The post  Ramayana Box Office Day 11 Advance Booking: Beats Dhurandhar To Enter Top 5 Biggest 11th Day Before First Show On 2nd Sunday Begins!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Absolute box office mayhem has gripped the nation on Day 11, the Second Sunday for Ramayana! Following a record-shattering Second Saturday that saw it smash into the 700 crore domestic net club, director Nitesh Tiwari’s mythological epic continues its unbelievable pre-sales momentum for second Sunday, November 15.
Before the first morning show even commenced across theaters today, Ramayana locked in a staggering 37.10 crore gross (excluding blocked seats) from 11.49 lakh tickets sold across 24,500 shows in India. Translating to a massive 31.40 crore net collection, the film has already stormed into both the Top 5 Biggest 11th Days of Bollywood!
Relying solely on its 31.40 crore net advance booking, the film has already overtaken the full-day 11th Day net collection of Dhurandhar before spot walk-ins begin, placing Jawan, Stree 2 , and Dhurandhar 2 in a fairly shaky situation. In all probability, they will shift a spot lower on day 11’s list!
Simultaneously, Ramayana’s 31.40 crore net collection has already pushed past the complete Second Sunday net totals of Dangal and Saiyaara, setting up a massive climb in this list as afternoon and evening family crowds arrive in the theaters.
* denotes only advance booking numbers for day 11, second Sunday!
The film needs just 2.14 crore in over-the-counter spot bookings to pass Ranbir Kapoor’s Animal and 2.87 crore to overtake Shah Rukh Khan’s Jawan. Ramayana is guaranteed to surge into the Top 5 Second Sundays by afternoon!
With 31.40 crore net already banked before the first show and 11.49 lakh tickets sold at an average ticket price of Rs 326 , Ramayana needs roughly 31.61 crore in spot walk-ins across the day to challenge Dhurandhar 2’s all-time Second Sunday record of 63 crore .
